title: Spa Metric2 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:metric2
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day spa metric2 (2) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on spa metric2 (2) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It scans what time of day your spa metric2 (2) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
